title: Livewave
features: Live feed discovery: live-now grid, featured stream, categories, trending, search
Viewer watch screen: full-screen video, live comments overlay, viewer count, follow
Reactions (floating hearts) and virtual gifts paid with coins
Host go-live: camera preview, title, category, streaming engine choice (Agora / LiveKit / WebRTC), quality preset
Host live room: broadcast timer, live viewer count, incoming comments, gift alerts, pin and mute moderation, end stream
Stream health diagnostics: bitrate, FPS, latency, packet loss, auto-reconnect log with backoff
Post-stream summary: duration, peak viewers, new followers, gifts earned, average latency
Coin wallet: balance, top-up packs, creator earnings
Creator profile with past streams (replays) and schedule
Stream settings: low-latency mode, adaptive bitrate, auto-reconnect, QA debug overlay

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, 5 tabs in this exact order. Active tab icon + label in accent #8E4BC7, inactive in text.tertiary. Go Live tab icon sits in a small accent circle. Reused verbatim on every nav-bearing screen.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Red LIVE pill (danger #DC2626 fill, white bold 'LIVE' 13px) + viewer count pill (dark translucent rgba(22,12,31,.55) fill, white eye icon + number) - same component on every stream card and every live video screen.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, accentFill #8E4BC7, white 16/600 label, pressed #7D42AF, disabled 40% opacity. Secondary button: pill, white fill, 1.5px border #8E4BC7, accent label. Text input: 12px radius, white, 1px borderStrong, focus = 2px accent ring, error = danger. Card: 20px radius, white, soft shadow. Chip: pill, accentTint fill, accent-dark text 13/600.

screens.name: welcome
screens.purpose: First-run onboarding: what the app is, sign in or continue
screens.content: Full-bleed real photo of a smiling young woman streaming from her phone on a ring-light tripod in a cozy studio, soft purple light. Gradient overlay bottom (accent to dark). App logo mark small at top. Headline 'Go live in seconds'. Sub 'Stream, chat and earn with your community in real time.' Primary pill 'Get started', secondary text link 'I already have an account'. Three page dots.

screens.name: home
screens.content: Header 'Livewave' wordmark-free: greeting 'Hi, Maya' + search icon + bell. Focal: large featured live card (real photo of a DJ behind turntables with neon, LIVE pill, '12.4K' viewers, title 'Friday Night House Set', creator 'DJ Kairo' with avatar). Section 'Following - live now' horizontal row of circular avatars with accent ring + LIVE tag (Lena Park, Marco Ruiz, Aiko Tan, Sam Okafor). Section 'Live now' 2-column grid of 4 stream cards (cooking, guitar acoustic, fitness HIIT, travel walking tour Lisbon) each real photo thumbnail, LIVE pill, viewer count, title, creator name.

screens.name: home-empty
screens.purpose: Home when no followed creators are live
screens.content: Same header. Empty state: real photo of a quiet home studio desk with an unlit ring light and phone on tripod. Title 'Nobody you follow is live'. Body 'Follow creators to get notified when they go live.' Primary pill 'Explore live streams'. Below, small row 'Suggested creators' with 3 avatar chips + Follow buttons.

screens.name: explore
screens.purpose: Browse categories, trending streams and search
screens.content: Search input 'Search creators, streams, tags'. Category chips row: All (active), Music, Gaming, Cooking, Fitness, Talk, Travel, Art. Focal: 'Trending' horizontal carousel of tall 3:4 stream cards with real photos (painter at canvas, chef plating, street musician), LIVE pills + viewer counts. Section 'Top categories' 2x2 tiles with real photos and live counts ('Music - 1.2K live'). Section 'Rising creators' list rows: avatar, name, category, followers, Follow pill.

screens.name: creator-profile
screens.purpose: View a creator channel before or after watching
screens.content: Cover real photo of a guitarist in a warm-lit room, back arrow. Avatar overlapping cover with LIVE ring + LIVE pill. Name 'Lena Park', handle '@lenaplays', bio 'Acoustic covers every night 8pm'. Stats row: 48.2K followers, 312 streams, 4.9 rating. Buttons: primary 'Watch live', secondary 'Following'. Section 'Schedule' rows (Mon 8:00 PM Acoustic requests, Wed 8:00 PM Songwriting). Section 'Past streams' 2-col replays with duration badges and view counts.

screens.name: watch-live
screens.purpose: Viewer watches a live stream and chats
screens.content: Full-screen real photo of Lena Park singing with acoustic guitar facing camera, warm light. Top overlay: creator avatar + name + white Follow pill, LIVE pill, viewer pill '2,481', close X. Right side vertical action rail: heart (with count 18.3K), gift, share, more. Bottom-left live comments overlay, 6 messages on dark translucent bubbles with avatar + bold name + text (e.g. 'Ava: play Yellow please!', 'Kenji: hello from Tokyo', system row 'Marco sent a Rose x5' with gift icon in support green). Floating hearts rising on right. Bottom bar: comment input 'Say something...' on dark translucent pill, gift button, heart button. Small connection-quality dot 'HD' chip top-right.

screens.name: gift-sheet
screens.purpose: Send a virtual gift to the creator
screens.content: Dimmed live video photo behind. Bottom sheet white, 24px top radius, grabber. Title 'Send a gift' + coin balance chip '1,250 coins' + 'Top up' link. Grid 4x2 of gifts as flat 2D vector icons (Rose 1, Heart 5, Coffee 10, Star 25, Mic 50, Rocket 100, Crown 500, Wave 1000) each with name + coin price, one selected (accent border + tint). Quantity stepper x1 x5 x10. Primary pill 'Send Rocket - 100 coins'.

screens.name: go-live-setup
screens.purpose: Host prepares a stream before going live
screens.content: Top: camera preview card (real photo of a young man smiling into front camera in a bright room) with flip camera, mic and beauty toggle icon buttons overlaid. Input 'Stream title' filled 'Morning coffee and Q&A'. Category chip selector (Talk selected). Card 'Streaming engine' segmented control: Agora (selected), LiveKit, WebRTC with caption 'Ultra low latency, under 400 ms'. Card 'Quality' segmented: 480p, 720p (selected), 1080p + toggle 'Adaptive bitrate' on. Pre-flight check row: Network 'Good - 18 Mbps up' green check, Camera ok, Mic ok. Focal: large primary pill 'Go Live' with broadcast icon.

screens.name: host-live
screens.purpose: Host is broadcasting and manages the room
screens.content: Full-screen real photo of the host (young man with coffee mug) facing camera. Top overlay: LIVE pill + timer '00:24:17', viewer pill '1,034', health chip 'Excellent 3.2 Mbps' with green dot, End button (danger outline). Gift alert banner mid-left: 'Sofia sent a Crown x1 +500' on support green tint. Bottom-left comments overlay with 5 messages; one comment pinned at top with pin icon. Long-press menu hint on one comment showing small action chips 'Pin', 'Mute', 'Remove'. Bottom row of round icon buttons: mic, flip camera, beauty, stream health (activity icon), comments toggle.

screens.name: stream-health
screens.purpose: Host or QA checks live stream diagnostics
screens.content: Header back arrow + 'Stream health' + green status chip 'Stable'. Focal: big numeral card '3.2 Mbps' bitrate with a 60-second line chart (accent line, support second series 'target'). 2x2 metric tiles: FPS 30, Latency 312 ms, Packet loss 0.4%, Resolution 720p. Card 'Connection' rows: Engine Agora RTC, Region Singapore, Network Wi-Fi, Encoder H.264 hardware. Card 'Reconnect log' timeline: 00:18:02 Network dropped - reconnecting (warning icon), 00:18:04 Retry 1 after 1s, 00:18:06 Reconnected in 3.8s (success). Toggle row 'Show debug overlay on video'.

screens.name: live-summary
screens.purpose: Host sees results after ending the stream
screens.content: Soft accent to support gradient hero with white check icon, title 'Stream ended', subtitle 'Morning coffee and Q&A - 52 min'. Focal stat: '2,940' peak viewers large numeral. 2x3 stat grid: Total views 8,412, New followers +186, Comments 1,203, Gifts earned 6,450 coins, Avg watch time 7m 40s, Avg latency 318 ms. Card 'Top supporters' 3 rows with avatars + coins. Primary pill 'Save replay', secondary 'Share highlights', text link 'Back to home'.

screens.name: wallet
screens.purpose: Buy coins and see creator earnings
screens.content: Title 'Wallet'. Focal: gradient balance card 'Coin balance 1,250' with coin glyph + 'Earnings $214.60 this month' sub-row and 'Withdraw' small pill. Section 'Top up' 2x3 grid of coin packs (100 - $0.99, 500 - $4.99, 1,200 - $9.99 'Popular' tag, 2,500 - $19.99, 6,500 - $49.99, 14,000 - $99.99). Section 'Recent activity' list: Sent Rocket to Lena Park -100, Received Crown from Sofia +500, Top up +1,200.

screens.name: profile
screens.content: Avatar real photo of Maya Chen (young woman, purple sweater) + name + '@mayalive' + edit pill. Stats row: 3,210 followers, 184 following, 46 streams. Focal: card 'This week' with mini bar chart of hours streamed (support bars) and 'Peak 2,940 viewers'. Tabs Replays / Clips / Scheduled. 2-col replay grid with real photo thumbnails, duration badge, views. Settings gear top-right.

screens.name: stream-settings
screens.content: Header back + 'Stream settings'. Group 'Video': Default quality 720p row, Frame rate 30 fps row, toggle Adaptive bitrate on, toggle Low-latency mode on. Group 'Reliability': toggle Auto-reconnect on, row Max retries 5, row Backoff 'Exponential 1s to 16s'. Group 'Engine': row Default engine Agora, row Region Auto. Group 'Developer and QA': toggle Debug overlay off, toggle Simulate poor network off, row 'Export session logs'. Group 'Chat': toggle Slow mode, row Blocked words 12.

type.minSize: 12px (13px chips and tags, 14px safety or legal text)
type.scaleRule: Use only the 5 declared sizes (display, title, body, label, caption).

designSystem.icons: rounded outline, 24px, 1.75 stroke, one set (Lucide style)
designSystem.a11y: white labels on #8E4BC7 only; support green carries dark #160C1F labels; text over video uses dark translucent bubbles rgba(22,12,31,.55) with white text; taps >= 44pt

results.pair: accentFill as link text on background
warning text on its tint and on surface
success text on its tint and on surface
danger text on its tint and on surface
support as chart line / icon on surface (non-text 3:1)
